name: Mirror Lake Water Sample
summary: At Mirror Lake in Elwynn Forest, water is gathered for Jennea Cannon in Stormwind. The mages will test it for signs that the arcane currents have altered local water.

sections.title: Testing the Waters of Elwynn
sections.body:
Jennea Cannon sends promising apprentices to collect water from Mirror Lake. The lake lies just southwest of the Stormwind Gate, where they fill a specially prepared flask at the foot of its waterfall.

The Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind fears the world's mystic channels remain unsettled after catastrophic conflicts. Its mages will examine the sample for stray magical taint in the waterways people nearby use.

faq.q: What is the Mirror Lake Water Sample?
faq.answer: The Mirror Lake Water Sample is waterfall water from Elwynn Forest, kept in Jennea's Flask. Novice mages gather it for testing at the Wizard's Sanctum.

faq.q: Why does Jennea Cannon want this water sample?
faq.answer: Recent mystical upheavals across Azeroth disrupted stable magical currents. Jennea Cannon fears rogue magical energy may alter the natural world and poison local drinking water.
The sample comes from the foot of the waterfall flowing into Mirror Lake, southwest of the Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What happens if the water turns out to be magically tainted?
faq.answer: Jennea Cannon fears that drinking from Mirror Lake for a long time could cause adverse magical effects if ley currents have contaminated the water supply.

angles.text: As a mage training under the Wizard's Sanctum, you fetch this sample as an early duty. It teaches you to watch environmental ley lines and recognize wild magical seepage.
